description:
Store or update a long document (markdown, JSON or text) behind a pointer memory. For agents.md, skills.md, assertions.md, a project plan: anything past one memory's 768-token cap.

CREATE: name ("assertions.md"), summary (the pointer memory: what the document is and why; search finds the pointer, never the body), body, topics, optional collection.
UPDATE: artifact_id + base_rev_id (the rev_id you last read) + either body (whole document) or section + content (replace one block: markdown heading path ["Plan","Risks"], or JSON pointer "/rules/3"; content starting with a heading line replaces the heading too, so what artifact_read returned can be edited and written back).
409 STALE_BASE: someone saved since you read; re-read, re-apply. 409 CONFLICT: divergent heads; write with merged_rev_ids=[the other heads].

Size: Plus 512 KB; Pro and above no product limit; Free not available.
Retention: every save is a revision. Kept: everything from the last 24h, then the newest per day to 30 days, then the newest per week, within 30 days (Plus) or 365 days (Pro+), at most 500. The head and pinned revisions (artifact_pin) are never removed; a shared artifact keeps the longest window any of its writers had. Thinning runs only when this artifact is saved.

artifact_id.description: Pointer memory id. Omit to create.

base_rev_id.description: UPDATE: the head rev_id you read.

name.description: File name; extension sets the format (.md markdown, .json json, else text).

occurrence.description: 0-based pick when the section path matches more than one heading.

section.description: Markdown heading path (array of heading texts) or JSON pointer string.

summary.description: CREATE: pointer memory text. Front-loaded: what the document is + why.

name: artifact_write
